Name: S'ivaa
Description: After the death of the Old Gods and before the rise of the new, there was a time when monstrous shadow elementals walked the cosmos. The last of them remaining is S'ivva, the Old God Dancer of destruction, a powerful divine monster whose dance could destroy the universe. When the New Gods came to power, S'ivva fell asleep under the eternal sea on New Genesis, there sleeping undisturbed for eons.
